content.text:
Finding submitted.

**ASSIGN — deviation (high).**

- **p0149 (General Provisions (c) ASSIGNMENT):** one-way, blanket bar on our assignment — no affiliate or M&A carve-out, no reasonableness standard on Licensor's consent, and no restriction at all on Licensor assigning (including to a competitor of ours).
- **p0134 (Article XX):** our Change of Control *automatically terminates* the Agreement and all licenses absent Licensor's prior written consent, with Licensor "deemed to have reasonably withheld" consent whenever it merely believes its interests may be adversely affected.

Together these sit in walk-away territory under the rule, so they fail the fallback as well as the preferred position.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** adds a consent-free carve-out for assignment to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger/sale of substantially all assets; makes the residual consent requirement mutual and not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed; bars Licensor from assigning to our competitor; and replaces the change-of-control termination trigger with a simple post-closing notice, preserving the existing "CHANGE OF CONTROL" definition that follows. The comment offers the fallback (mutual assignment to successors on notice) as a landing zone.
